title: Frappe ERPNext 15.x 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.x before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, to access Sales Order and Purchase Order data for records outside their permission scope by sending crafted requests. The vulnerability does not affect confidentiality of other data types or system integrity and availability.
